remaining_native_corpus_discrepancy.observed: In the temporary mixed-printing corpus, the normal dsc/223 and khm/216 printings fail fo:enters while the reversible sld/1807 printing matches it. This causes one missing ID in the grouped KHM case and the same extra ID in its negated case.
remaining_native_corpus_discrepancy.scope: The discrepancy also occurs with fo:enters, so it is independent of the added is:etb alias. The production mirror, queried with fo:enters, matches Scryfall on every page of these same cases. The exact cause inside the limited corpus was not established; no engine, importer, or tag-index changes were made for it.
